name: Kimon Youitan
source:
The hero was living a normal school life, but recently some strange incident has happened around it. The hero has the blood of ancient demon flowing and thus he is  chosen to stop the resurrection of "Kidon" that threatens Tokyo. Will you fight to destroy the threat or  become a demon yourself and destroy humankind? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本过着普通的校园生活，但最近周围发生了一些怪事。他体内流淌着远古恶魔之血，因此被选中阻止威胁东京的‘鬼门’复活。你会为消灭威胁而战，还是亲自化身恶魔、毁灭人类？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
